description:
There seemed to be many broken links and intra-doc links in the rust docs, fixed a bunch of them along with a few other warnings.

However I am not able to fix some intra-doc links and I don't known if they are possible to fix. 
They have in common in that they are links in sqlx-core and they need to reference an item from the other libraries, for example in [pool](https://github.com/launchbadge/sqlx/blob/0eb2ee93650eaf10d9cadc107a88bfabfdf377a7/sqlx-core/src/pool/mod.rs#L19-L22), but since they are not dependencies of sqlx-core i don't seem to be able to reference them (if they were dependencies it would cause a cyclic dependency however).

comments.body: A Duration type distinct from time::Duration and chrono::TimeDelta seems to not exist anymore
This is actually a copypaste error. The method doesn't return `Transaction`, it's lower level than that.
These four lines (506-510) can be deleted since they're an implementation detail anyway.
This would be `std::time::Duration`. `Type` and `Decode` impls are defined in `mysql_time.rs`
Thank you! i don't know how i missed it :sweat_smile:
Can you fix the formatting here? The vertical bars (`|`) should all be aligned.
